name: Russia
description: Follow Russia, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: House passes Russia sanctions bill, overcoming Democratic opposition
changes.summary: The bill was championed by GOP Sen. Lindsey Graham, who died suddenly just one day after announcing a deal had been reached with the White House to move forward.

changes.title: Expert: Images of damaged U.S. bases in Middle East show Iran "getting help from Russia and China"
changes.summary: CBS News has exclusively gained access to photos that show widespread damage at U.S. bases in the Middle East as a result of the war with Iran. Former Defense Department official Matthew Kroenig joins "The Takeout" with his reaction.

changes.title: DOJ charges Russian agents with plotting attacks, including in the U.S.
changes.summary: The indictment says the defendants belong to a network that "is one arm of the Russian Federation's apparatus used to carry out external attacks" worldwide. (Image credit: Kevin Dietsch).

changes.title: Congress Clears Russia Sanctions Bill, Sending It to Trump
changes.summary: The bipartisan measure targets financing for Russia’s war against Ukraine as attacks intensify. It passed the House over the objections of Democrats who opposed handing President Trump new tariff powers.

changes.title: Extended Interview: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy
changes.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy speaks with CBS News' Aidan Stretch about the state of the war, Russia's recent escalation, U.S. support and more.

changes.title: DOJ accuses Russian intel agents of plotting to murder U.S.-based dissident
changes.summary: The Justice Department is accusing several members of Russia's intelligence services of running a "global assassination network" that targeted Kremlin critics.

changes.title: Russia seizes Ukrainian POWs, then it demands favors from their relatives
changes.summary: Russia is believed to be holding thousands of Ukrainian POWs. Russia is also tormenting the families of these prisoners by contacting their relatives on social media and demanding they help Russia. (Image credit: Francisco Seco).

changes.title: Russia’s Election Result Won’t Be a Shock. What Comes Next Could Be.
changes.summary: Russians are braced for what may follow for the military and economy after a parliamentary election that the Kremlin sees as a means of legitimizing its policies.

changes.title: U.S. Has Deployed Weapons in Space, Air Force Secretary Says
changes.summary: Troy E. Meink’s comments were the first public acknowledgment of American weapons in orbit. The Pentagon has been preparing for potential conflict in space with Russia or China.

changes.title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine will pause strikes on Russia if Kremlin spares critical infrastructure
changes.summary: His comments Monday follow President Donald Trump's claim that Russia and Ukraine agreed not to target each other's energy infrastructure.
